title: Latvian and Lithuanian PMs stress eastern border security
summary_full: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) was playing host to his Lithuanian counterpart Mindaugas Sinkevičius on Thursday, August 20th for talks and what was supoosed to be a joint visit to the Belarusian border.
